```{r setup}
#| code-summary: "Setup: waves, pairs and models"
source(here::here("common.R"))
library(lme4)

scores_all <- load_levante_latest("scores")
trials <- load_levante_latest("trials")
scores <- clean_levante_latest(scores_all, trials) |> add_waves()
data_ref <- unique(scores_all$redivis_source)

# each child's first run in each wave of a task
by_wave <- scores |>
  group_by(dataset, user_id, task_id, wave) |>
  slice_min(time_started, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(dataset, user_id, task_id, task_label, task_category, wave, score,
         score_se, age, adaptive, time_started)

# all pairs of a child's waves of a task; within a gap bin a child and task
# contribute their earliest pair only
gap_breaks <- c(3, 9, 15, 21, 30)
gap_labels <- c("3–9", "9–15", "15–21", "21–30")
pairs <- by_wave |>
  inner_join(by_wave, by = c("dataset", "user_id", "task_id", "task_label",
                             "task_category"),
             suffix = c("1", "2"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(wave2 > wave1) |>
  mutate(gap_months = as.numeric(difftime(time_started2, time_started1,
                                          units = "days")) / 30.4,
         gap_bin = cut(gap_months, gap_breaks, labels = gap_labels),
         same_mode = adaptive1 == adaptive2)
first_pairs <- pairs |> filter(wave1 == 1, wave2 == 2)

# empirical reliability of EAP scores in each dataset and task:
# var(EAP) / (var(EAP) + mean(SE^2)), from first-wave runs
reliability <- by_wave |>
  filter(wave == 1, !is.na(score_se)) |>
  group_by(dataset, task_label) |>
  summarise(rel = var(score) / (var(score) + mean(score_se^2)), .groups = "drop")

# pool within-dataset correlations with Fisher z, weighted by n - 3
pool_r <- function(df) {
  df |>
    summarise(z = weighted.mean(atanh(r), n - 3), w = sum(n - 3), n = sum(n),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(r = tanh(z), lo = tanh(z - 1.96 / sqrt(w)),
           hi = tanh(z + 1.96 / sqrt(w))) |>
    select(-z, -w)
}

# stability by gap bin, within dataset (20+ pairs), then pooled
stab_gap <- pairs |>
  filter(!is.na(gap_bin)) |>
  group_by(dataset, task_label, gap_bin, user_id) |>
  slice_min(wave1, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  group_by(dataset, task_label, gap_bin) |>
  filter(n() >= 20) |>
  reframe(cor_ci(score1, score2))
stab_gap_pooled <- stab_gap |> group_by(task_label, gap_bin) |> pool_r()

# stability between the first two waves, observed and corrected for
# measurement error
stab_first <- first_pairs |>
  group_by(dataset, task_label) |>
  filter(n() >= 20) |>
  reframe(cor_ci(score1, score2)) |>
  left_join(reliability, by = c("dataset", "task_label")) |>
  mutate(r_corrected = pmin(r / rel, 1))
stab_first_pooled <- stab_first |>
  group_by(task_label) |>
  pool_r() |>
  left_join(stab_first |>
              filter(!is.na(r_corrected)) |>
              group_by(task_label) |>
              summarise(r_corrected = tanh(weighted.mean(atanh(pmin(r_corrected, .999)), n - 3)),
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = "task_label") |>
  arrange(r)

# growth: within-child slope (age deviation from the child's mean age, so
# only change within children counts) with the child's mean age and, where
# both forms occur, adaptive vs fixed form as covariates
growth_data <- by_wave |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) |>
  group_by(dataset, user_id, task_id) |>
  mutate(age_child = mean(age), age_within = age - age_child,
         n_waves = n()) |>
  group_by(dataset, task_id) |>
  filter(n_distinct(user_id[n_waves >= 2]) >= 30) |>
  ungroup()

fit_growth <- function(df) {
  f <- if (n_distinct(df$adaptive) > 1) {
    score ~ age_within + age_child + adaptive + (1 | user_id)
  } else {
    score ~ age_within + age_child + (1 | user_id)
  }
  m <- lmer(f, data = df, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  est <- fixef(m)[["age_within"]]
  se <- sqrt(vcov(m)["age_within", "age_within"])
  tibble(within = est, within_lo = est - 1.96 * se, within_hi = est + 1.96 * se)
}

cross <- by_wave |>
  filter(wave == 1, !is.na(age)) |>
  group_by(dataset, task_id) |>
  summarise(cross = coef(lm(score ~ age))[["age"]], .groups = "drop")

slopes <- growth_data |>
  group_by(dataset, task_id, task_label, task_category) |>
  group_modify(\(df, key) fit_growth(df)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(cross, by = c("dataset", "task_id"))

long_ds <- first_pairs |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  summarise(children = n_distinct(user_id), gap = median(gap_months),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(children >= 20) |>
  arrange(desc(children))
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Summary

**Data:** `r data_ref`. A child's runs of a task count as separate waves
when they are at least 90 days apart.

- `r fmt_n(n_distinct(first_pairs$user_id))` children have a task in two or
  more waves, in `r nrow(long_ds)` datasets with 20 or more such children.
  The median gap between the first two waves ranges from
  `r round(min(long_ds$gap))` to `r round(max(long_ds$gap))` months.
- Children's scores rise between waves: the within-child slope is positive
  in `r sum(slopes$within > 0)` of `r nrow(slopes)` dataset × task cells,
  and larger than the cross-sectional age gradient in
  `r sum(slopes$within > slopes$cross)` of them.
- Stability between the first two waves, pooled within datasets, is highest
  for `r stab_first_pooled$task_label[nrow(stab_first_pooled)]`
  (r = `r f2(max(stab_first_pooled$r))`) and lowest for
  `r stab_first_pooled$task_label[1]` (r = `r f2(min(stab_first_pooled$r))`).
  For most tasks it falls as the gap between waves grows.
- `r fmt_pct(mean(!first_pairs$same_mode, na.rm = TRUE))` of first-to-second
  wave pairs switch between the adaptive and fixed forms of a task.
:::

# Who has repeat data

```{r repeat-data, fig.height=4.5}
repeat_cells <- first_pairs |>
  count(dataset, task_label, name = "children") |>
  mutate(dataset_label = factor(dataset_labels_named[dataset],
                                levels = rev(dataset_labels_named[long_ds$dataset]))) |>
  filter(dataset %in% long_ds$dataset)

ggplot(repeat_cells, aes(x = task_label, y = dataset_label, fill = children)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt_n(children), colour = children > 60), size = 3.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "white"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
```

Each cell is the number of children with a task in two waves. The first two
waves are a median of
`r paste0(round(long_ds$gap), " months apart in ", dataset_labels_named[long_ds$dataset], collapse = ", ")`.

# Growth

Each child's scores across waves, by task:

```{r trajectories, fig.height=8, fig.width=9}
traj <- by_wave |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) |>
  semi_join(first_pairs, by = c("dataset", "user_id", "task_label")) |>
  filter(dataset %in% long_ds$dataset)

ggplot(traj, aes(x = age, y = score, group = interaction(dataset, user_id),
                 colour = dataset)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(vars(task_label), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_dataset(name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, linewidth = 1))) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Score") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

Within-child growth against the cross-sectional age gradient, for each
dataset and task with 30 or more children in two waves. The within-child
slope comes from a mixed model that separates each child's change from
their mean age, with adaptive vs fixed form as a covariate where both
occur; bars are 95% CIs. The dotted line is equality.

```{r slopes, fig.height=5.5}
slopes |>
  mutate(dataset_label = factor(dataset_labels_named[dataset],
                                levels = dataset_labels_named[long_ds$dataset])) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cross, y = within, colour = task_category)) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = within_lo, ymax = within_hi), width = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = task_label), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE,
                           max.overlaps = 30) +
  facet_wrap(vars(dataset_label)) +
  scale_colour_task(name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Cross-sectional slope (score per year of age)",
       y = "Within-child slope (score per year)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

The within-child slope is larger than the cross-sectional gradient in
`r sum(slopes$within > slopes$cross)` of `r nrow(slopes)` cells. Within-child
change includes any practice effect from taking the task again, so it is not
a pure estimate of development. The slopes below zero are
`r with(filter(slopes, within < 0), paste0(task_label, " in ", dataset_labels_named[dataset], " (", f2(within), ", 95% CI ", f2(within_lo), " to ", f2(within_hi), ")", collapse = "; "))`.

# Stability

How strongly a child's score in one wave predicts their score in the next,
computed within each dataset. For the first two waves: observed (filled)
and corrected for measurement error using each task's empirical reliability
in that dataset (open). Pooled across datasets with Fisher's z; bars are
95% CIs.

```{r stability-first, fig.height=4.5}
stab_first_pooled |>
  mutate(task_label = factor(task_label, task_label)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = task_label)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), width = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(x = r), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = r_corrected), shape = 1, size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(NA, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Correlation between the first two waves", y = NULL)
```

ROAR-Sentence has no standard error, so it has no corrected value. The
correction uses empirical reliabilities of
`r f2(min(stab_first$rel, na.rm = TRUE))`–`r f2(max(stab_first$rel, na.rm = TRUE))`
across these datasets and tasks.

By gap between waves, using all pairs of a child's waves (each dataset's
correlation in colour, pooled in black):

```{r stability-gap, fig.height=7, fig.width=9}
ggplot(mapping = aes(x = gap_bin, y = r)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_point(data = stab_gap, aes(colour = dataset),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1),
             alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_pointrange(data = stab_gap_pooled, aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), size = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = stab_gap_pooled, aes(group = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(task_label)) +
  scale_colour_dataset(name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Months between waves", y = "Correlation") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r gap-trend}
gap_trend <- stab_gap_pooled |>
  group_by(task_label) |>
  filter(n() >= 2) |>
  summarise(first = r[which.min(as.integer(gap_bin))],
            last = r[which.max(as.integer(gap_bin))], .groups = "drop")
```

Pooled stability is lower at the longest gap than at the shortest for
`r sum(gap_trend$last < gap_trend$first)` of the `r nrow(gap_trend)` tasks
measured at more than one gap.

# Notes

- **Waves and pairs.** A run at least 90 days after a child's previous run
  of the same task starts a new wave; each wave is represented by its first
  run. Repeat runs within 90 days (re-administrations) are ignored here.
- **Adaptive and fixed forms.** Pairs that switch form are included. The
  growth models adjust for form; the stability correlations do not.
- **Measurement error.** The corrected correlations divide by each task's
  empirical reliability for EAP scores, var(EAP) / (var(EAP) + mean SE²),
  in that dataset; they assume the same reliability in both waves.

# Revision history

- **2026-10-30.** Rewritten on the pinned release, merging "02 —
  Longitudinal traces and simple growth models" and "Test–retest figures"
  (both on the 2026-08 per-site snapshot). Growth now uses a within-child
  slope that is separated from children's mean age, and stability is
  computed within dataset by gap between waves, with a correction for
  measurement error. Both old pages are in `archive/`.
